_comment_case: Stage 2 (measured mean shape): ONE flagellum on the cell body, rest shape = measured
time-averaged flagellar shape of swimming cells in water (Qin et al. 2015; Gutierrez et al. 2025,
Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.sbcc2frj6): curvature ~1 rad/um over the first ~2 um, ~0.25 rad/um up to ~0.4 L,
then decreasing to ~0 distally; total turning ~125 deg.  Attachment site at 13 deg from the cell axis,
Beat target (1 cP data): curvature amplitude ~0.3 rad/um (tapering over the distal ~30 %),
curvature-wave wavelength ~18-21 um (1.7-2.0 L), tangent-angle RMS ~0.75 rad.
The active moment is the custom moment of chlamydomonas/chlamy_moment_fun.m injected by
chlamydomonas/chlamy_run_case.m (ov.moment); amplitude_Nm below is only a placeholder.

custom_geometry._comment_body: Prolate spheroid c = 5 um (X), a = 4 um (Pradipta et al. 2025, CC-125); 400 surface points.
custom_geometry._comment_sites: Attachment sites at polar angle 13 deg from the cell axis: (c cos 13, +-a sin 13) = (4.87185, +-0.89980) um (basal-body separation 1.80 um). Root half-angle 13 deg. Site 1 = +Y flagellum.

pili._comment: Flagellum on +Y side. frozen = rest shape is the measured mean shape. Beat plane = XY: d2 = +Z, so the bending moment is d2_amp = 1.

_comment_material: Axoneme + membrane hydrodynamic radius 0.125 um.  E is an EFFECTIVE modulus chosen so that
EI = E*pi*r^4/4 = 840 pN um^2 (intrinsic axonemal rigidity, Xu et al. 2016, CC-124).
sigma_p only affects twist, which a planar beat does not excite.
_comment_fluid: Water, mu = 1 mPa s (as in Pradipta et al.).  Neutrally buoyant: swimming only, no sedimentation.

simulation._comment_T_obs: 6 beats at 50 Hz.  Discard the first 1-2 beats (start-up transient from the initial phase).
simulation._comment_dt: dt is only the output sampling stride: 1 ms = 20 frames per beat.
